svg.title: Poles in a Chromatic Sea
svg.desc: The rational map (z^3 - 1)/(z^3 + 1) exchanges three zeros and three poles. Phase is hue, while logarithmic magnitude bands turn the six singular structures into a vibrating topological fabric.
